name: After recital G
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: Ga. whereas corruption, by diverting public funds from their intended purpose of benefiting the public, reduces the level and quality of essential public services, including health, education, justice and social care, hence directly undermining the fundamental rights of citizens as enshrined in the Charter, and in particular the right to health (Article 35), the right to education (Article 14), the right to an effective judicial remedy (Article 47) and the right to social protection (Article 34); whereas this direct link between corruption and the violation of fundamental rights means that the combating of corruption must be viewed not only as an instrument of good governance but also as an essential precondition for the effective respect of fundamental rights; whereas there are documented cases in several Member States in which corruption has undermined the provision of essential public services, to the detriment of the most vulnerable groups in society in particular;
